newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble lower after funds set aside for T-bills, OFZ.
newsitem.headline: Rouble lower after funds set aside for T-bills, OFZ.

text.p: The rouble eased on Wednesday as
bank demand for funds for today's sales of government securities

Today the Finance Ministry is auctioning 7.50 trillion roubles of 364-day GKO discount Treasury bills and 4.00 trillion roubles in an additional 707-day tranche of the two-year OFZ bonds maturing March 1999.
roubles/dollar Apr 23 midday Apr 23 early Apr 22 close
"Yesterday it could be felt that non-residents were selling dollars actively for the auctions but today it is calm and the dollar is still able to edge up," one dealer said.
Dealers said the rouble was likely to ease further until the weekend, with the trend depending mostly on whether bank clients would need more roubles or dollars these days.
